title: Titanium Missile Airframe Skin
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is mandated for Titanium Missile Airframe Skin because its specific strength (290 kN·m/kg) outperforms 4340 steel by 55% and 7075 aluminum by 35% at temperatures up to 400°C. The duplex alpha+beta microstructure provides damage tolerance against high-cycle vibration spectra typical of airframe structures. Its fatigue crack growth rate (da/dN ~2×10^-8 m/cycle at ΔK=20 MPa√m) enables safe-life design for Missile body skin panel. This rationale is driven by missile body skin panel and fat life requirements.
process: 5-axis CNC roughing for missile hardware geometry
Wire EDM contour profiling for net-shape tolerance
CMM per AS9102 for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Shot peening Almen 0.008-0.012A inducing compressive residual stress for extended HCF life in aerospace service — tailored for missile body skin application
commonFailures: Fretting fatigue at dovetail interface - mitigated by shot peen Almen 0.008A + dry-film lubricant coating — critical for missile body skin performance

faq.q: Does Titanium Missile Airframe Skin meet AMS specifications?
faq.a: Titanium Missile Airframe Skin is manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V per AMS 4928 (bar/rod) or AMS 4911 (sheet/plate) with mechanical property verification at room and elevated temperature. Heat treatment per AMS 2801 (solution treat 925-980°C + age 510-540°C) provides STA condition properties. All processing is documented per AS9102 FAI requirements for missile body skin.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Missile Airframe Skin orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Missile Airframe Skin is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Missile Airframe Skin?
faq.a: Each Titanium Missile Airframe Skin shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for missile body skin.
